title: Explicit quotient-valued Koszul dual complex and reduction morphism
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal, r a natural number and f:Fin r→A. Let K=K_A(f) [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex] and L=Hom_A(K,A) with the signed differential [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex]. Define T^p=Hom_A(K_p,A/I), with differential x↦(-1)^(p+1)x∘d_(p+1). Define c:L→T by c^p(x)=(A→A/I)∘x. These explicit differentials square to zero and c commutes with them. No regularity or generation hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: lemma-regular-immersion-ext, affine dual Koszul coefficient comparison

proof.text: Signed precomposition squares to zero because consecutive Koszul differentials compose to zero. Postcomposition with the A-linear quotient map commutes with precomposition and with the sign scalar. Apply CochainComplex.of and CochainComplex.ofHom to these proved identities; this constructs the complex and morphism as data, with no existential choice.
